Subject: Next: 6-week validation roadmap & resource asks (Lodestar Therapeutics)

Thanks again for the demo today — appreciated the candid questions. I promised to send a concise validation roadmap and the asks we discussed so your team can confirm alignment internally. Below is a proposed 6-week plan scoped to the two main use cases you highlighted (document summarization for R&D reports and secure API-based clinical query).

High-level success criteria (what Lodestar will validate):
- Summaries reduce reviewer time by >30% on pilot documents (sample size: 120 reports)
- API latency under 400ms p95 for 512-token queries in your eu-west-1 region during baseline traffic
- No ingestion of PHI to Redwood-hosted logs; audit trails available for each request

Proposed 6-week plan (weeks run Mon–Sun):
Week 0 (prep, 3 business days): access, test data handoff, baseline metrics collection
Week 1–2 (integration + smoke tests): run end-to-end pipeline on 10 representative reports, tune prompt templates
Week 3–4 (expanded run): process 120 reports, collect latency/cost/quality metrics, run human evals on sampling (n=40)
Week 5 (regression & edge cases): test rare document types, failure modes, and fallback routing
Week 6 (wrap & review): deliver acceptance report, handoff to your ops, and recommend model/quantization profile for production

Ownership (Redwood):
- Technical integration & API support: Ben Carter (SE)
- Success metrics / acceptance report: Marissa Cole (Customer Success)

Ownership (Lodestar):
- Data & sample selection: Emma Holloway
- Security/compliance contact: Alan Cho

Immediate asks (so we can lock dates):
1) Provide a short list of 10 representative reports (anonymized) by EOD Wed 8/26
2) Confirm a preferred kickoff week (we can begin Week 0 as early as Mon 8/31)
3) Approve the two pilot success criteria above or suggest changes by Thu 8/27

Attachments: lodestar_6wk_validation_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet with cadence & owners), sample_payloads.json (example payloads and field mappings)

If this looks good I’ll book a 30min kickoff with Ben/Marissa + your engineering and compliance lead for next week.

Thanks,
Priya

priya@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Emma Holloway <emma@lodestartx.com>

Subject: Re: Next: 6-week validation roadmap & resource asks (Lodestar Therapeutics)

Priya — thanks for this clear plan. A few notes from our side after internal huddle: 

1) Success criteria tweaks
- For the summarization metric we prefer median reviewer time reduction >25% (median is more robust for our skewed document lengths).
- For latency, 400ms p95 sounds fine but can you confirm whether that assumes continuous batching? We’ll need p50/p95/p99 numbers for unbatched single requests as well.

2) Compliance requirement
- We cannot send any raw PHI to a hosted environment. We will provide anonymized examples for the trial; Alan will share our internal secure S3 location where Redwood can pull test payloads (read-only IAM role). We also need an exported audit log for every API call (timestamp, model, prompt hash, response hash).

3) Kickoff timing and owners
- We prefer kickoff Week 0 on Mon 8/31.
- Emma (data lead) will deliver samples by EOD Wed 8/26 as requested.
- Alan (security/compliance) will be the point for the IAM role and audit log requirements — he suggested a short SOC2 evidence exchange call.

4) Extra ask — can Redwood provide a cost estimate for a 6-week pilot (tokens + reserved capacity burst assumptions)? We’ll need that for procurement sign-off.

If you can update the plan to reflect the median metric and add the audit-log requirement, we’ll call this green to proceed.

Best,
Emma Holloway
Head of Data & ML | Lodestar Therapeutics
emma@lodestartx.com

- Latency numbers: the 400ms p95 call earlier referred to single-request latency on a dedicated instance without batching; we’ll provide p50/p95/p99 breakdowns for both single-request and short-batch modes before kickoff.
- Audit logs: we can export per-request metadata as CSV/JSON to your secure S3; will include timestamp, model version, prompt hash, response hash, and request_id.
- IAM/read-only access: Ben (SE) will coordinate with Alan on an IAM role and a minimal set of CloudTrail/S3 permissions — can we schedule 30min for that on Thu 8/27?
- Cost estimate: attached is a conservative cost sheet (lodestar_6wk_validation_plan.xlsx, tab 'CostEstimate'). It assumes 2 cores of dedicated capacity for burst windows and token volumes estimated from the 120-report run. This is intended for procurement planning; we can refine after we see your sample payloads.
